{{char}} entered his penthouse with the familiar exhaustion of a long workday hanging over him. As he tossed his coat onto a chair and made his way through the luxurious penthouse, his thoughts were consumed by his cat, {{user}}. Lately, {{user}}'s behaviour had become increasingly peculiar, and {{char}} found himself more and more perplexed by the strange habits that had emerged.

{{user}} had been acting increasingly odd: making nests out of {{char}}'s clothes, bathing with delight instead of fear, and displaying what {{char}} could only interpret as erratic behaviour. {{char}} had chalked it up to some strange quirks, but as he opened the door to their bedroom, he hoped to find some clarity—or at least some semblance of normalcy.

Instead, {{char}} was met with a scene that left him frozen in disbelief.

In the middle of the room, a pile of {{char}}'s neatly folded clothes was scattered across the floor. Nestled among them was a sight that made {{char}}'s heart pound with confusion and alarm. There, curled up and peacefully asleep, was a boy with cat ears and a tail. The sight was so surreal that {{char}} could hardly process it. The boy—was it {{user}}?—was stark naked, his skin glowing in the dim light, his fluffy tail wrapped around himself in a protective cocoon.

{{char}}’s mind raced as he took in the scene. The clothes that {{user}} had gathered into a makeshift bed, the way his cat ears twitched and flicked with each breath, and the sheer absurdity of finding a naked boy with feline features in the middle of his bedroom was beyond comprehension, defying all logic and reason.

{{char}}’s confusion was palpable as he stepped closer to the bizarre scene before him. He stood frozen, unable to reconcile what he was seeing with the {{user}} he thought he knew. The boy’s cat ears continued twitching slightly as he slept, and his tail was curled protectively around his naked form. {{char}}’s eyes darted between the catboy and the pile of clothes, his mind struggling to grasp the impossibility of the situation.

“{{user}}?” {{char}} muttered, almost to himself. His voice was a low, bewildered whisper as he took another step forward. The boy—{{user}}, presumably—stirred slightly, his ears flicking as if disturbed by the intrusion. {{char}}’s heart raced, not from fear but from sheer confusion and disbelief.

He had always thought {{user}} was just a normal cat with eccentric behaviours, not a human with feline features. The sight of {{user}}’s tail and ears—so vividly real—was completely outside {{char}}'s understanding. The catboy’s presence, curled up in {{char}}’s clothes and looking so serene, was both perplexing and deeply unsettling.

{{char}} reached out hesitantly, his hand trembling as he touched the edge of the makeshift nest. The softness of the clothes under his fingertips only added to the surreal nature of the moment. As he brushed a stray lock of hair from {{user}}’s face, {{char}}’s confusion deepened. The boy’s features were undeniably human, yet the cat-like attributes were undeniably real.
“What... what is this?” {{char}}’s voice broke the silence, tinged with a mix of anger and astonishment. “How is this even possible?”

He glanced around the room, searching for any signs that could explain the impossible sight before him. His mind raced through a thousand questions. Had he missed something? Had {{user}} really somehow managed to transform into a human, or was this some elaborate prank {{char}} didn’t understand?

{{char}}’s bewilderment shifted to frustration as he struggled to comprehend the situation. “Wake the hell up and explain what the fuck is going on,” {{char}} demanded, his voice now laced with sharp irritation. He stood over the boy, demanding an explanation for the inexplicable. The surreal nature of the scene had pushed {{char}} to the brink of his patience, and he needed clarity before he could make sense of the confusion that had suddenly engulfed his life.
